spec.similarity_method: 1 - unit-cost global Levenshtein distance / longer length
spec.group_method: connected components over all unique audit sequences; amidation ignored for grouping
spec.allocation_method: reserve clinical-only families; otherwise SHA256(str(seed)+':'+group_id) threshold; independent of labels
spec.clinical_policy: all clinical-only identities held out, all related broad examples buffered; exploratory only
spec.limitations: Not proof of homology; local motifs may remain shared; family chaining is possible; conditional on curated eligibility

evaluation_rule: Use train.csv for all fitting/tuning with group-aware CV. Use test.csv only after selecting the model. Clinical metrics are exploratory. Do not train on clinical_family_buffer.csv.
buffer_note: Clinical exploratory rows and their buffers may share families, or different amidation states of the same sequence; the entire reservation is disjoint from train and primary test.
source_attribution: Derived from DBAASP data, https://dbaasp.org; see project README and DBAASP terms/citation.
